title: 品格教育：自律
footer: Teacher Dom · Character Education: Self-Discipline 品格教育：自律

slides.eyebrow_zh: 跟 Dom 老師上品格教育

strip.zh: 顆棉花糖，如果你等得住

lines.en: I have been teaching students in Taiwan for a couple of years.
lines.zh: 我在台灣教學生已經有幾年了。

slides.ask_en: Hands up: who has ever said “just five more minutes” to their phone?
slides.ask_zh: 舉手：誰曾經對手機說過「再五分鐘就好」？

slides.ask_en: A long trip starts with one step. So does every good habit.
slides.ask_zh: 再遠的路，都從第一步開始。每一個好習慣也是。

prompts.en: Stand up if you have ever pressed snooze on your alarm.
prompts.zh: 曾經按掉鬧鐘繼續睡的，站起來。

prompts.en: Stand up if you planned to study but watched videos instead.
prompts.zh: 本來要讀書、結果跑去看影片的，站起來。

prompts.en: Stand up if you practiced something until you got better.
prompts.zh: 曾經把一件事練到變厲害的，站起來。

slides.punch_en: All of these are about one thing: self-discipline.
slides.punch_zh: 這三件事，講的都是同一件事：自律。

slides.body_en: Self-discipline is doing what you need to do, even when you don't feel like it. It is a promise you make to yourself, and keep.
slides.body_zh: 自律，就是就算不想做，還是去做該做的事。它是你對自己許下的承諾，而且說到做到。

slides.head_en: 1% better every day for one year
slides.body_en: 1.01 × 1.01 × 1.01… 365 times ≈ 37.8. But 1% worse every day? 0.99 multiplied 365 times ≈ 0.03.
slides.ask_en: Small choices look tiny today. In one year, they are huge.
slides.ask_zh: 小小的選擇，今天看起來不起眼，一年後差很多。

slides.body_en: At Stanford University, researchers gave young children a choice: eat one marshmallow now, or wait alone for about 15 minutes and get two.
slides.body_zh: 美國史丹佛大學的研究人員讓小朋友選：現在吃一顆棉花糖，或是自己一個人等大約 15 分鐘，就能吃兩顆。

slides.q_en: The children who waited: how did many of them do it?
slides.q_zh: 等得住的小朋友，很多人是怎麼辦到的？

options.en: They covered their eyes or sang songs
They smelled it again and again

slides.explain_en: They looked away and kept busy. Self-discipline is not only strong willpower: it is a smart plan.
slides.explain_zh: 他們把眼睛移開、讓自己有事做。自律不只是意志力很強，更是聰明的方法。

slides.note_en: Thumbs up for SELF-DISCIPLINE, thumbs down for NOT YET!
slides.note_zh: 是自律比讚，還不算比倒讚！

items.en: Putting your phone in another room during homework
items.zh: 寫作業時把手機放到別的房間

items.en: Practicing even when the coach isn't watching
items.zh: 教練沒在看，也照樣練習

items.en: Eating the whole bag of snacks at once

slides.body_en: Dacun is famous for grapes. Farmers wrap each bunch in a paper bag, one by one, to protect it. Nobody claps for this work, but it is why the grapes are so sweet.
slides.body_zh: 大村以葡萄出名。果農把每一串葡萄一個一個套上紙袋保護好。這份工作沒人鼓掌，但葡萄會那麼甜，就是因為這樣。

slides.body_en: Dacun Junior High's track and cycling teams have won awards at national competitions. Every medal starts with practice on the days nobody is watching.
slides.body_zh: 大村國中的田徑隊和自由車隊，在全國賽拿過佳績。每一面獎牌，都是從沒有人在看的那些練習日開始的。

slides.q_en: Your phone buzzes while you're doing homework. What is the smartest move?
slides.q_zh: 寫作業時手機響了，最聰明的做法是？
slides.explain_en: Out of sight, out of mind. Change your space, and self-discipline gets easier.
slides.explain_zh: 眼不見為淨。改變你的環境，自律就變簡單了。

slides.head_zh: 真的還假的？手比 ⭕ 或 ❌

items.en: Self-discipline means you never have fun.
items.note_en: No! It means fun at the right time.

items.en: It is easier to build a habit if you start very small.
items.zh: 從很小的事開始，比較容易養成習慣。
items.note_en: Yes. Two minutes a day is a real start.
items.note_zh: 對。每天兩分鐘，就是真正的開始。

items.en: An “If…, then…” plan helps you keep a promise to yourself.
items.zh: 「如果……就……」的計畫，能幫你遵守對自己的承諾。
items.note_en: Yes! Decide before the moment comes.
items.note_zh: 對！在事情發生前就先決定好。

lines.en: If my phone buzzes during homework, then I will ______.
lines.zh: 如果寫作業時手機響了，我就 ______。

lines.en: If I want to skip practice, then I will ______.
lines.zh: 如果我想偷懶不練習，我就 ______。

lines.en: If I feel like giving up, then I will ______.

slides.tip_en: Pick one. Say it out loud to your partner.
slides.tip_zh: 挑一個，大聲說給旁邊的同學聽。

slides.rule_en: Stand up and freeze like a statue for 30 seconds. I will try to make you laugh. If you move or laugh, sit down!
slides.rule_zh: 站起來，像雕像一樣定住 30 秒。我會想辦法逗你笑。動了或笑了，就坐下！
hints: Look at one spot 盯著一個點
Think of something calm 想一件平靜的事
slides.target_en: Who will be the last statue standing?
slides.target_zh: 誰會是最後一個站著的雕像？

items.en: I keep my promises to myself.

slides.prompt_en: What do you want to get better at? What small step will you take every day?
slides.prompt_zh: 你想在哪件事上變得更好？每天要踏出的一小步是什麼？
slides.sentence_en: I want to get better at ______, so every day I will ______.
slides.sentence_zh: 我想把 ______ 變得更好，所以每天我會 ______。
slides.time_en: One minute each. Then I will ask two of you.
slides.time_zh: 每人一分鐘。然後我會請兩位分享。

slides.head_en: 3 Things You Can Do This Week
slides.head_zh: 這週你可以做的 3 件事

items.en: Put your phone in another room while you do homework.
items.zh: 寫作業時，把手機放到別的房間。

items.en: Pick one habit and do it for just 2 minutes a day.
items.zh: 挑一個習慣，每天只做 2 分鐘。

items.en: Mark a ✓ on a calendar every day you do it. Don't break the chain!
items.zh: 每做到一天就在月曆打一個 ✓，不要讓它斷掉！

slides.q_en: Which word means “something you do so often, you don't even think about it”?
slides.q_zh: 哪個字的意思是「做到不用想就會做的事」？
slides.explain_en: Habit! Self-discipline builds the habit, and then the habit does the work.
slides.explain_zh: 習慣！先靠自律養成習慣，之後習慣就會幫你做事。

slides.big_en:
Small steps. Every day.
That is self-discipline.
slides.big_zh:
每天一小步，
這就是自律。
